description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'parseOverrides' that uses TypeScript compiler API to parse a TypeScript/JavaScript source file, traverse its AST, and generate modified source code with inserted comments for classes and their members. It exports the 'parseOverrides' function.

methods.name: parseOverrides
methods.description: Asynchronously parses a source file to insert comments for classes and members based on provided callback functions, returning the modified source code.

methods.name: getIndentationAtPos
methods.description: Determines the indentation whitespace at a given position in the source file.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits AST nodes to identify class or interface declarations and serialize them.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes class or interface nodes by inserting comments for the class and its members.

methods.name: visitProperties
methods.description: Recursively visits property and method signatures within class/interface nodes to insert comments.
